17 cards in `physics/particle/`. Select every card whose "Applies when" line matches the paper, and open only those. Paths are relative to this folder. The index of all folders is [../../INDEX.md](../../INDEX.md).

| T-ACCELERATOR-PHYSICS | Accelerator and beam physics | technique | the paper reports measured beam emittance, energy spread, bunch charge or beam size, a luminosity computed from beam parameters, calibration of beam instrumentation, or the energy gain, gradient or beam quality of a new acceleration scheme such as plasma or dielectric acceleration | [accelerator-physics.md](accelerator-physics.md) |
| T-AXION-SEARCHES | Axion and hidden-sector searches | technique | the paper reports a haloscope, helioscope, light-shining-through-walls or hidden-photon search, or bases a limit on, or a candidate for, an axion-photon coupling, an axion-like particle or a dark photon kinetic mixing on such data | [axion-searches.md](axion-searches.md) |
| T-BLIND-ANALYSIS | Blind analysis | technique | the paper states that its analysis was blind or blinded, hid a signal region, the result, the event count or part of the data until unblinding, used a hidden offset or added or removed events, or reports changes made after unblinding | [blind-analysis.md](blind-analysis.md) |
| T-CALORIMETRY-JETS | Calorimetry, jets and missing energy | technique | the paper measures energies with calorimeters, reconstructs or calibrates jets, uses missing transverse momentum, or bases a claim on a jet energy scale or resolution, a jet or missing-momentum spectrum, an invariant mass built from jets, or a correction for pile-up | [calorimetry-jets.md](calorimetry-jets.md) |
| CL-STANDARD-MODEL-DEVIATIONS | Claims of deviations from the Standard Model | claim | the paper reports an anomaly, tension or deviation between a measured quantity and its Standard Model prediction, quotes a significance for that difference, combines such differences in a global fit, or interprets them as a sign of new physics | [standard-model-deviations.md](standard-model-deviations.md) |
| T-AIR-SHOWERS | Cosmic-ray and air-shower arrays | technique | the paper uses a ground array of particle detectors, fluorescence or Cherenkov telescopes to reconstruct extensive air showers, and reports a cosmic-ray energy spectrum, mass composition, depth of shower maximum, muon content, arrival-direction anisotropy or a test of hadronic interaction models | [air-showers.md](air-showers.md) |
| T-DARK-MATTER-DIRECT | Dark matter direct detection | technique | the paper searches for dark matter scattering off nuclei or electrons in a low-background detector, reporting a recoil spectrum, threshold, quenching factor or background model, or claims an excess, an annual modulation or a cross-section exclusion limit from such a search | [dark-matter-direct.md](dark-matter-direct.md) |
| T-DETECTOR-DEVELOPMENT | Detector development and performance | technique | the paper presents a new or prototype particle detector, sensor or readout chip and reports its detection efficiency, spatial, time or energy resolution, rate capability, radiation tolerance or ageing from test-beam, source, laser or irradiation measurements | [detector-development.md](detector-development.md) |
| T-FIXED-TARGET | Fixed-target and beam-dump experiments | technique | the paper searches for new particles made by a proton or electron beam on a fixed target or in a beam dump, through decays or scattering behind a shield or a resonance in the products, or normalizes a yield or limit to particles on target | [fixed-target.md](fixed-target.md) |
| T-MONTE-CARLO-GENERATORS | Monte Carlo generators and detector simulation | technique | the paper uses Monte Carlo event generators or detector simulation to predict signals or backgrounds, correct data for detector effects, derive efficiencies or acceptances, or compare a measurement with theory, or relies on a generator tune or simulation-based modelling uncertainty | [monte-carlo-generators.md](monte-carlo-generators.md) |
| T-NEUTRINO-OSCILLATIONS | Neutrino oscillation experiments | technique | the paper measures neutrino oscillation parameters with accelerator, reactor or atmospheric neutrinos, compares near and far detector spectra, reconstructs neutrino energy from final-state particles, or claims a preference for a mass ordering, CP violation or a value of the CP phase | [neutrino-oscillations.md](neutrino-oscillations.md) |
| T-PRECISION-COLLIDER | Precision measurements at colliders | technique | the paper reports a total, fiducial or differential cross section measured at a particle collider, corrects collider data for detector effects by unfolding, extracts a Standard Model parameter such as a mass or coupling from such data, or combines such measurements | [precision-collider.md](precision-collider.md) |
| T-RARE-DECAYS | Rare decays and lepton-flavour violation | technique | the paper measures the branching fraction of a rare decay or sets a limit on a forbidden one, including lepton-flavour-violating decays and muon-to-electron conversion, using a normalisation channel or a count of produced particles and a background estimate in a signal window | [rare-decays.md](rare-decays.md) |
| T-NEW-PARTICLE-SEARCHES | Searches for new particles | technique | the paper searches collider data for a new particle, resonance or other signal beyond known processes, or reports an excess over an estimated background, a local or global significance, a look-elsewhere correction, or upper limits on a cross-section, coupling or mass | [new-particle-searches.md](new-particle-searches.md) |
| T-STATISTICAL-INFERENCE-HEP | Statistical inference in particle physics | technique | the paper claims a discovery, evidence or significance for a signal, or sets an upper limit, exclusion region or confidence interval on a signal rate, cross section, coupling or other parameter using a likelihood fit, CLs, Feldman-Cousins or Bayesian limits | [statistical-inference-hep.md](statistical-inference-hep.md) |
| T-TRACKING-PID | Tracking and particle identification | technique | the paper reconstructs charged-particle tracks or vertices, applies track, vertex or particle identification selections, quotes tracking efficiency, fake rate, momentum scale or resolution, vertex resolution or misidentification rates, or bases a claim on identified hadrons, leptons or displaced vertices | [tracking-pid.md](tracking-pid.md) |
| T-TRIGGER-LUMINOSITY | Trigger, selection efficiency and luminosity | technique | the paper reports a cross section, event rate, branching fraction or limit at a collider that depends on trigger or selection efficiencies, tag-and-probe or data-to-simulation scale factors, integrated luminosity, or the modelling of pile-up | [trigger-luminosity.md](trigger-luminosity.md) |
